user.title: Add a child
user.description: Track temperature, illness and medication for one child. Add one entry per child. Data stays on your Home Assistant instance.

data_description.copy_from: Copies the fever threshold, recheck time, medicines and symptom types from another child. Names, dates of birth and logged history are not copied.

error.birth_date_in_future: Date of birth can't be in the future.

abort.already_configured: A child with this name has already been added.

menu_options.add_symptom: Add an illness or symptom type
menu_options.remove_symptom: Remove an illness or symptom type

data_description.fever_threshold: A reading at or above this is flagged as a fever. Set it to the value your doctor or health service advises.
data_description.recheck_minutes: After a reading at or above the fever threshold, remind you to take another if none is logged within this time. A normal reading cancels the reminder.

add_medicine.title: Add a medicine
add_medicine.description: Enter the minimum time between doses exactly as shown on the medicine's label, or as advised by your doctor or pharmacist. This integration only records doses and reminds you. It never calculates or suggests a dose.

add_symptom.title: Add an illness or symptom type
add_symptom.description: Something you want to log each time it happens, such as vomiting or diarrhoea. 'All clear after' is how many hours with no further episode before it is shown as clear and you are notified. Many schools and nurseries use 48 hours for sickness and diarrhoea, but check the policy that applies to you.

remove_symptom.title: Remove an illness or symptom type

copy_settings.title: Copy settings from another child
copy_settings.description: Replaces this child's fever threshold, recheck time, medicines and symptom types with another child's (temperatures are converted if the units differ). Logged history is kept, but entities for symptom types or medicines that are replaced are removed.

error.medicine_exists: A medicine with this name already exists.

log_symptom.name: Log a symptom
log_symptom.description: Record a bout of something like vomiting or diarrhoea. The all-clear timer restarts from this time.

symptom.name: Symptom
symptom.description: One of the symptom types set up for this child.

occurred_at.name: When it happened
occurred_at.description: Leave empty for now. Set it to log something that happened earlier.

log_temperature.name: Log a temperature
log_temperature.description: Record a temperature reading. A reading at or above the fever threshold fires a fever event.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: In the unit chosen for this child.

occurred_at.name: When it happened
occurred_at.description: Leave empty for now. Set it to log something that happened earlier.

log_dose.name: Log a dose
log_dose.description: Record a medicine given. It is refused if it is sooner than the minimum interval you set, unless you override. This only records; it never suggests a dose.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.description: One of the medicines set up for this child.

occurred_at.name: When it happened
occurred_at.description: Leave empty for now. Set it to log something that happened earlier.

override.name: Log anyway
override.description: Record it even though it is sooner than the minimum interval.

fail_if_too_soon.name: Error if too soon
fail_if_too_soon.description: When off, a dose that is too soon is not logged and the response says so (with when the next dose is allowed) instead of raising an error. Used by the notification blueprint.

start_episode.name: Start an illness episode
start_episode.description: Mark the start of an illness.

end_episode.name: End the illness episode
end_episode.description: Mark the current illness as over.

delete_entry.name: Delete a record
delete_entry.description: Remove a logged record by its id (see Get history).

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Return recent symptoms, temperatures, doses and episodes, including record ids.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back to include.

unknown_child.message: That child isn't set up in Child Health.

child_not_loaded.message: That child's entry isn't loaded right now.

unknown_symptom.message: {child} has no symptom type called {name}. Add it in the integration options first.

unknown_medicine.message: {child} has no medicine called {name}. Add it in the integration options first.

future_time.message: The time can't be in the future.

temperature_out_of_range.message: {value} doesn't look like a valid temperature in {unit}.

dose_too_soon.message: Based on the {hours}-hour interval you set for {medicine}, the next dose is allowed from {next_allowed}. Check the label, or set 'Log anyway' to record it.

episode_already_open.message: {child} already has an open illness episode. End it first.

record_not_found.message: No record with id {id} was found.
